scope: Tablelands Regional Council Division 1 postal by-election and councillor taking office

sources.finding: Full postal ballot. Completion and receipt were separate deadlines.
Official result declares Gregory Kevin English elected. First preferences total 2,345 formal votes. Result display last updated 11:56 am on 11 November.
Greg English made his Declaration of Office at 3 pm on 11 November 2026 and formally took up the Division 1 role.

previousEventEvidence.status: Postal vote completion closed; receipt of returns continues
previousEventEvidence.dateBasis: The postal vote completion deadline, 31 October 2026 at 18:00 AEST, has elapsed. Receipt remains open until 10 November at 17:00 AEST. No result declaration was established. These are distinct deadlines; no winner or in-person voting is inferred. Verified 1 November 2026.
previousEventEvidence.contestantNote: The contestant roster and result declaration are not independently verified in this collection. Follow the official record; the elapsed completion deadline does not establish a winner.
